summary: Language-Wise NLP Model Evaluation on Rythu Mithra Corpus

Pure Telugu.notes: Strong semantic alignment with Telugu vocabulary and agricultural morphological stems.

Telugu-English Code-Mixed.notes: XLM-RoBERTa cross-lingual subword tokenizer successfully maps technical English crop/pest terms embedded in Telugu syntax.

Pure English.notes: Limitation: No pure English agricultural symptom descriptions were available in the cleaned classification test split. English queries are handled via cross-lingual transfer and agricultural synonym lookup with safety fallback.

limitations: Severe language skew: Raw dataset was 94.4% Telugu, resulting in zero pure English test samples after deduplication.
Small sample sizes for rare classes (e.g. Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus has support 2, Blast has support 2 in the test split).
Softmax calibration drift on conversational inputs requiring certainty thresholding.
